verdict.rationale: Stripe docs say refunds can be issued through the Refunds API or the Dashboard, with step-by-step Dashboard instructions. Terminal in-person payments are managed alongside online payments in the same Dashboard, so those refund paths plausibly cover Terminal charges. However, nothing shows refunds started from the point of sale or reader, and partial refunds and return to the original card are not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: refund initiation from the POS or reader, explicit partial-refund support, confirmation that refunds return to the original card, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
